def flood_fill_from_boundary(grid, exclude_val):
    """Find all cells that can reach the boundary without touching exclude_val"""
    visited = set()
    reachable = set()
    queue = [(r,c) for r in range(len(grid)) for c in range(len(grid[0])) 
              if r==0 or r==len(grid)-1 or c==0 or c==len(grid[0])-1]

        blocked = False
        dr = pr - r
        dc = pc - c
        steps = max(abs(dr), abs(dc))
        
        if steps > 1:

                tr = r + int(i * dr / steps)
                tc = c + int(i * dc / steps)
                if (tr, tc) != pos and grid[tr, tc] == 8:
                    blocked = True
                    break
        
        if not blocked:
            visible_to.append((pr, pc))
    
    # Convex hull point should see at least 3 non-collinear points
    return len(visible_to) >= 3
